description: Metro Istanbul: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Metro Istanbul. Coverage: Metro Istanbul. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Rail Systems Wagon Mileage Information; Completed Site Information For Rail Systems; RAIL SYSTEMS LINE BASED FLIGHT NUMBERS; Information on Transfer of Rail Systems. Formats seen: XLSX, API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
